events.deciding_variable: Record total loss frequency and ACV, plus pricing and international growth, outweighed a 7.5% Q4 decline in US insurance unit volumes. Revenue $1.2B +2.4% BEAT while EPS $0.35 MISSED (-14.6% YoY, net income -17.4% to $327.4M) - and the stock went UP anyway.
events.lesson: Issues NO forward guidance as a matter of policy, so GG is permanently None here and the model runs at reduced completeness on this name by construction. The market trades TOTAL LOSS FREQUENCY and ACV - the structural volume drivers - and will look straight through a double-digit decline in reported net income to get at them. Do not read an EPS miss as the deciding variable on this name.
